title: DOM and events
summary: Select elements from the page, change their text and classes, create and remove elements, and respond to clicks and form submissions. You will reproduce the parentheses mistake in addEventListener, handle a whole list with one delegated listener, carry data on elements with data attributes, and keep the list across a reload with localStorage.
changeNote: Rewritten so each step opens with an explainer or a prediction, folds the background under Read more, and ends with a quiz.
